build_zero_shot_classifier: build a zero-shot classifier by encoding class names with templates into normalized text embeddings
run_zero_shot_classification: run zero-shot classification on a dataloader using a CLIP model and precomputed classifier weights
evaluate_zeroshot_metrics: evaluate zero-shot classification metrics including accuracy and mean per class recall on a dataset
compute_topk_accuracy: compute top-k classification accuracy from model logits and ground truth target labels
compute_average_precision: compute average precision per class for multi-label classification from scores and one-hot targets
